name: Soluble Dream
source:
Venture into a world of passion, temptation and mystery. Starring Jackson Taylor, a brilliant programming student who must make tough decisions while guarding his reputation and struggling with himself.

Embodying Jackson, you, along with scientists Katie Martinez and Rachel Brown, will plunge into an exciting project to create an AI capable of synthesizing unique substances. Soon the heroes discover that their discovery has a narcotic effect, and Jackson decides to start its secret sale, plunging them all into the dark world of illicit affairs.
Success seems close, but everything changes with the arrival of a mysterious hacker named "Phantom" who threatens to expose their secret. Struggling with his demons and increasing addiction, it's up to Jackson to find a way out of this dangerous game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
走进充满激情、诱惑与谜团的世界。主人公杰克逊·泰勒，是一位才华横溢的编程专业学生，他必须作出艰难选择，维护自己的声誉，同时与内心斗争。

扮演杰克逊，与科学家凯蒂·马丁内斯、蕾切尔·布朗，一同投身激动人心的项目：创造能够合成独特物质的人工智能。很快，他们发现，自己的成果具有麻醉致幻作用。杰克逊决定秘密出售这种物质，将所有人拖入非法勾当的黑暗世界。
成功似乎近在咫尺，可一个名为“幻影”的神秘黑客出现，威胁揭露他们的秘密，一切随之改变。内心的阴暗与日渐加深的成瘾不断纠缠，杰克逊必须设法走出这场危险的游戏。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516040/]Steam[/url]]
